question: Which of the following was one of the five states formed by breaking up the Bahmani kingdom?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Golkonda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Bahmani Sultanate was a Muslim state of the Deccan in South India and one of the great medieval Indian kingdoms.
 
• After the collapse of the Bahmani kingdom, it was divided into five Deccan Sultanates: Golkonda, Bijapur, Ahmednagar, Bidar, and Berar.
 
• Golkonda was one of these five states and became a prominent center due to its diamond mines, including the famous Kollur Mine.
 
• The Qutb Shahi dynasty ruled Golkonda, and the region is known for its contributions to architecture, including the construction of the famous Golkonda Fort.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bahmani Sultanate:**

 
 
• Founded in 1347 by Ala-ud-Din Hasan Bahman Shah after revolting against the Delhi Sultanate.
 
• It was the first independent Islamic kingdom in South India.
 
• The kingdom played a significant role in the history of the Deccan region until its decline in the early 16th century.
 
 
 
• **Qutb Shahi Dynasty:**
 
 
• Ruled the Golkonda Sultanate from 1518 to 1687.
 
• Known for their patronage of Persian culture and language, as well as the development of regional architecture.
 
• The dynasty's rule ended when the Mughal Emperor Aurangzeb captured Golkonda in 1687.
 
 
 
• **Golkonda Fort:**
 
 
• Originally a mud fort built by the Kakatiya dynasty in the 13th century.
 
• Expanded and fortified by the Qutb Shahi rulers to become a formidable stronghold.
 
• Famous for its advanced acoustics, palaces, and the Fateh Darwaza (Victory Gate).
 
 
 
• **Diamond Mines:**
 
 
• Golkonda was renowned for its diamond mines, which were among the most productive in the world.
 
• Notable diamonds from these mines include the Koh-i-Noor, Hope Diamond, and the Regent Diamond.
 
• The wealth from these mines significantly contributed to the prosperity of the region.
